functional.question: How many sellers are there?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many products are in the catalogue?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders are there in total?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders have been delivered?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were cancelled?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many distinct product categories are there?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) FROM products LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories have the most products, using the Portuguese category names?
functional.sql: SELECT T3.product_category_name_english, COUNT(T1.product_id) AS product_count FROM order_items AS T1 JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id JOIN category_translation AS T3 ON T2.product_category_name = T3.product_category_name GROUP BY T3.product_category_name_english ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the average product weight in grams?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(product_weight_g) FROM products ORDER BY product_weight_g ASC LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 states have the most sellers?
functional.sql: SELECT seller_state FROM sellers JOIN order_items ON sellers.seller_id = order_items.seller_id GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders were placed in 2017?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the highest price paid for a single item?
functional.sql: SELECT T1.price FROM order_items AS T1 INNER JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id INNER JOIN orders AS T3 ON T1.order_id = T3.order_id WHERE T3.order_status = 'shipped' GROUP BY T1.product_id ORDER BY T1.price DESC LIMIT 1

functional.question: How many order items are there?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers generated the most revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT T3.seller_id FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id JOIN sellers AS T3 ON T2.seller_id = T3.seller_id WHERE T1.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY T3.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(T2.price) DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 product categories generated the most revenue?
What is the average freight value per item?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(freight_value) FROM order_items AS T1 INNER JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id INNER JOIN order_payments AS T3 ON T1.order_id = T3.order_id GROUP BY T1.product_id LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers sell the most distinct products?
functional.sql: SELECT T2.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.product_id) AS num_products_sold FROM order_items AS T1 JOIN sellers AS T2 ON T1.seller_id = T2.seller_id GROUP BY T2.seller_id ORDER BY num_products_sold DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders are there in each status?
functional.sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY order_status LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What was the total revenue in 2017?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.price + order_items.freight_value) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY order_status LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 products generated the most revenue?
What is the average number of items per order?
Which 5 seller states generated the most revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT T3.seller_state, SUM(T1.price + T1.freight_value) AS total_revenue FROM order_items AS T1 JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id JOIN sellers AS T3 ON T1.seller_id = T3.seller_id GROUP BY T3.seller_state ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders contain more than one item?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers received the most orders?
functional.sql: SELECT T3.seller_id, COUNT(T1.order_id) AS order_count FROM order_items AS T1 JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id JOIN sellers AS T3 ON T1.seller_id = T3.seller_id GROUP BY T3.seller_id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the total freight cost across all order items?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(freight_value) FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories have the highest average item price?
functional.sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, AVG(oi.price) AS average_price FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY average_price DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders were placed in each year?
functional.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY year LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which month of 2017 had the most orders?
functional.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%m', order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

functional.question: What is the average item price?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers have the highest average item price?
functional.sql: SELECT T2.seller_id FROM order_items AS T1 JOIN sellers AS T2 ON T1.seller_id = T2.seller_id GROUP BY T2.seller_id ORDER BY AVG(T1.price) DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What was the total revenue in each year?
How many sellers have sold products in more than 3 different categories?
Which 5 product categories have the highest freight cost as a share of revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(oi.freight_value) / SUM(oi.price) * 100 AS share_of_freight_cost FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_payments AS op ON o.order_id = op.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY share_of_freight_cost DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 product categories are sold by the most distinct sellers?
functional.sql: SELECT T2.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.seller_id) AS seller_count FROM order_items AS T1 JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T2.product_category_name ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the average revenue per seller?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, AVG(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS average_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY s.seller_id LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were delivered later than the estimated delivery date?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_estimated_delivery_date > order_delivered_customer_date LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers generated the most revenue in 2018?
functional.sql: SELECT T2.seller_id FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id JOIN sellers AS T3 ON T2.seller_id = T3.seller_id WHERE T1.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' GROUP BY T2.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(T2.price + T2.freight_value) DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What share of orders were cancelled?
functional.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(order_id) FROM orders LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers have the highest average freight cost per item?
functional.sql: SELECT T2.seller_id FROM order_items AS T1 JOIN sellers AS T2 ON T1.seller_id = T2.seller_id JOIN products AS T3 ON T1.product_id = T3.product_id GROUP BY T2.seller_id ORDER BY AVG(T1.freight_value / T1.price) DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many sellers generated more revenue than the average seller?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(seller_id) FROM (SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id JOIN category_translation ON products.product_category_name = category_translation.product_category_name GROUP BY seller_id) AS revenue_per_seller WHERE total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT SUM(price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id JOIN category_translation ON products.product_category_name = category_translation.product_category_name GROUP BY seller_id) AS average_revenue) LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories have the heaviest average product weight?
How many orders have not been delivered yet?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE NOT order_status IN ('delivered', 'canceled') LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the average delivery time in days?
What is the average time in hours between an order being placed and approved?
What is the average revenue per order?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(order_items.price) AS average_revenue_per_order FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id GROUP BY orders.order_id ORDER BY average_revenue_per_order ASC LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which single order had the highest total value?
functional.sql: SELECT T1.order_id FROM orders AS T1 INNER JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id GROUP BY T1.order_id ORDER BY SUM(T2.price) DESC LIMIT 1

functional.question: Which 5 customer states generated the most revenue?
Which 5 customer states have the highest average order value?
Which 5 customer cities placed the most orders?
functional.sql: SELECT T2.customer_city FROM orders AS T1 JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id GROUP BY T2.customer_city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many customers have placed more than one order?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.customer_id) FROM orders AS T1 INNER JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id GROUP BY T1.customer_id HAVING COUNT(T2.order_id) > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What share of customers are repeat buyers?
Which payment types are used most often?
functional.sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM order_payments JOIN orders ON order_payments.order_id = orders.order_id GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_count DESC LIMIT 10

functional.question: What is the average number of payment instalments?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(payment_installments) FROM order_payments LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the total value paid by credit card?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(T2.payment_value) AS total_value_paid_by_credit_card FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_payments AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE T2.payment_type = 'credit_card' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories generated the most revenue, named in English?
How many orders were paid in more than one instalment?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.order_id) AS num_orders FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_payments AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE T2.payment_installments > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the total item revenue from orders paid by credit card?
What percentage of orders were paid by credit card?
functional.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.order_id) FROM orders AS T1 INNER JOIN order_payments AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE NOT T1.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were paid using more than one payment type?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.order_id) FROM orders AS T1 INNER JOIN order_payments AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id GROUP BY T1.order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.payment_type) > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were paid with a voucher combined with another payment type?
What is the median delivery time in days?
Which 5 customer states have the slowest average delivery time?
What share of order items were bought from a seller in the same state as the customer?
Which 5 customer states rely most on sellers from other states?
functional.sql: SELECT T4.customer_state, COUNT(T1.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id JOIN sellers AS T3 ON T2.seller_id = T3.seller_id JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.seller_id = T4.customer_id GROUP BY T4.customer_state ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5
